# SUNSTAR GUM

> Global oral care brand offering toothbrushes, interdental products, dental floss, and mouthwash across 20+ international markets.

SUNSTAR GUM is a leading dental hygiene brand with localized product offerings and marketing campaigns across North America, South America, and Europe. The site provides market-specific information for consumers seeking gum health solutions, interdental cleaning, and comprehensive oral care products.

## Key Topics

- GUM® brand
- Oral care products
- Gum health
- Interdental cleaning
- Toothbrushes
- Dental floss
- Toothpaste
- GUM® SOFT-PICKS®
- GUM® SONIC DAILY
- Mouthwash
- Dental hygiene
- Teeth cleaning
- Orthodontic care
- Gum care
- Children's dental care
